signup.title: Create an account
signup.emailWhy: Every code and every notice goes here, so it must be one you can open.
signup.phoneContactOnly: Buyers use this to reach you. It is not verified — we cannot send SMS yet.
signup.farmerNote: A farmer sells produce. We check your identity first, so buyers can bid with confidence.
signup.buyerNote: A buyer bids on produce. You can start straight away.
signup.businessWhy: This raises how much you can bid. You can add it later instead.
signup.buyerType: What kind of buyer are you?
signup.skipCost: You can bid up to {{amount}} until you add these.
signup.submittedBody: One of our team will check your documents. You can log in and sell produce once your account is approved.
signup.submittedEmail: We sent a receipt to {{email}}. Keep it — it has your status link.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.help: We will email you a 6-digit code.
forgot.codeSent: If that address has an account, a code is on its way to
forgot.logoutWarning: Resetting your password signs you out on every device.

status.title: Application status
status.help: Enter your email address and we will send you a code. No login needed.
status.emailHelp: The address you used to sign up.

state.pending_approval: Waiting for review. We will email you when it is decided.
state.active: Approved — your account is open. You can log in and sell produce.
state.rejected: Not accepted this time. You can correct it and submit again.
state.suspended: This account is suspended. Please contact support.

landing.heroTitle: Sell your crop at the price it is worth
landing.heroBody: Buyers bid against each other for your produce, and the money is held safely until you have been paid. No middleman deciding your price.

escrow.title: Money held safely
escrow.body: The buyer pays before anything ships, and the money is only released once delivery is confirmed.

verified.title: Checked sellers
verified.body: Every farmer is reviewed by our team before they can list produce, so buyers know who they are bidding with.

direct.title: Real market prices
direct.body: See what your crop is fetching across the country today, not what one trader tells you it is worth.

landing.liveBody: Live auctions from farmers across Bangladesh. Browse without an account.

farmer.b1: Your details are checked by our team once, so buyers can trust the listing.
farmer.b2: Quantity, grade and your lowest acceptable price. Buyers bid upward from there.
farmer.b3: The winning buyer pays into escrow before you ship. The money reaches you once delivery is confirmed.

buyer.b1: Takes a minute. You can start bidding immediately, up to your limit.
buyer.b2: Search by crop and district, see every bid, and place yours in one tap.
buyer.b3: Your money is held until you confirm the goods arrived — it is not handed over on trust.

landing.closingTitle: Free to join, free to bid
landing.closingBody: We take a small commission only when a sale completes. Nothing to pay to list produce or to place a bid.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.subtitle: A question, a problem, or something that is not working — tell us and we will look into it.

contact.emailHelp: So we can reply to you.
